description_en: Queries model authorizations for a workspace
description_zh: 查询业务空间模型授权
name: ListModelPermissions

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is required and cannot be empty
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间 ID（不可为空）
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. If the upper limit is exceeded, the error code InvalidParameter.maxResults is returned
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回数，默认 20，超过上限报 InvalidParameter.maxResults
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token (offset) for the next page. Do not pass this parameter for the first page
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The authorization query dimension. Valid values:

AUTHORIZED: models that have been authorized for the specified modelAction. Use this value together with modelAction.
AUTHORIZABLE: full authorizable catalog
parameters.help_zh:
授权态查询维度

AUTHORIZED：已授权指定modelAction 的模型，需要配合modelAction使用
AUTHORIZABLE：全量可授权目录
parameters.name: authorization_scope

parameters.help_en:
The authorization action dimension. Valid values:

INFERENCE: model inference authorization
parameters.help_zh:
授权 action 维度

INFERENCE：模型调用授权
parameters.name: model_action

fields.help_en: The exact match for a single model
fields.name: model

fields.help_en: The fuzzy match for the model name
fields.name: name
